<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Register a fixed structure"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sites/{siteCode}/structures"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Adds a site-scoped physical obstacle — a wall, column, office, conveyor, or other fixed object — to the warehouse map (ADR-0017). A FixedStructure is not a location: nothing can be stowed at it. The site must already exist. Publishes FixedStructureRegistered.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

  parameters={[{"name":"siteCode","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The site's code — the first segment of every LocationCode inside it.","schema":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z0-9]+$"},"example":"WH1"},{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-generated key (a UUID per logical submit, 1-128 printable ASCII characters) that makes a retried POST safe (ADR 0019, ADR 0044). Clients MUST always send it: the service runs on Postgres in every deployment (ADR 0039), so the header is always enforced and an absent key is answered 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`. A replay with the same key, method, path and body returns the original response verbatim plus the response header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. The key is global (not per route).","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"example":"5b0f6a0e-6a41-4c63-9f33-0c8f5c1d2a77"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
